source: Seller Central > Brand Analytics > Top Search Terms (weekly)
rank_meaning: Search Frequency Rank, 1 = most searched, lower is better. Amazon does not publish absolute counts.
note: Covers the raw01 collection (rhinestone, kundan-on-metal, ghungroo, wire, kada bangles) — distinct from glass-kundan-bangles.json, which is for the GVK2/KSG2/KMS2 glass bangle line.
full_audit_2026-10-23: Owner demanded every single backend keyword word be verified for BOTH (a) visually/materially matching the actual product and (b) real Amazon search visibility, with zero exceptions. Did both: viewed the hero image of all 23 unique active raw01 designs directly, AND individually tested every base-block and per-design word through live Brand Analytics (not reused from the older glass-category research). Words that failed either test were removed; findings below.

'floral' REMOVED for this one product on a visual-match failure (kept for raw01-12/23/27 where the image genuinely shows floral/petal shaping).
image_audit_findings.all_other_designs: Visually matched their current descriptor words correctly on direct image inspection — no other mismatches found.

per_design_note: Fixed 2026-10-23 after full audit. Dropped 'wire', 'bell', 'rope', 'filigree', 'charm', 'ring', 'bronze', 'twisted' — all confirmed zero search volume via direct Brand Analytics test, even where materially/visually accurate. The owner's rule is both match AND visibility; losing either disqualifies a word. 'bead'/'stack' swapped for the real-tested synonym 'stackable'. Some products (4, 6, 13, 25) now carry only 'ghungroo' as their unique lead word since their other design-technique descriptors (wire/rope/bell/ring) all tested dead — this is real, not an oversight.
title_pattern_decision: No 'Glass' substitute word was added to the title pattern for this category. 'bangles set for women' (rank 523) alone outranks every material-qualified variant tested by 30-300x, and the design name already carries the honest material word. Verified 2026-10-22.
color_word_note: gold/golden/silver are real, high-ranked, but ARE color claims — applying them to every product regardless of actual color caused a false-color-signal bug on the first build. Only COLOR_WORD_MAP in build scripts may add them, keyed to the row's actual Color attribute. Fixed 2026-10-22.

base_block_verified_2026-10-23.note: The old base block (from amazon-scale skill, inherited from the glass-bangle category) included 10 words that test as ZERO real search volume for bangles specifically on amazon.in as of this week, despite being legitimate Hindu festival/gifting words in general use. Removed all 10. This is now the verified base block for this category: churi chudi kangan karwa chauth bridal wedding navratri garba ethnic traditional indian jewellery stone kada.
